scripts.desk:dev: npm run desk:build && wrangler dev -c workers/api/wrangler.jsonc -c workers/pipeline/wrangler.jsonc --env preview --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c workers/api/wrangler.jsonc --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c workers/api/wrangler.jsonc --env preview
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run desk:build && wrangler deploy -c workers/pipeline/wrangler.jsonc --env preview && wrangler deploy -c workers/api/wrangler.jsonc --env preview
scripts.web:preview: npm run web:build && wrangler dev -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --env preview
scripts.deploy:web:preview: FDF_USE_SEED=1 npm run build -w @fdf/web && wrangler deploy -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --env preview
scripts.deploy:web: FDF_USE_SEED=0 npm run build -w @fdf/web && wrangler deploy -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --env production
